title: Pipit: photo resizer in KB for Android
description: Pipit compresses photos and signatures to the exact KB target your form requires, like 20 KB, 50 KB or 100 KB. 100% on-device and private. Free on Google Play.
og_title: Pipit: compress photos to the exact KB you need
og_description: Hit strict file size limits like 20 KB or 50 KB without trial and error. 100% on-device image compression and resizing. Free on Google Play.
ld_description: On-device photo resizer and compressor that hits exact file size targets in KB for visa, exam, and government forms.
tagline: Photo resizer in KB for Android
h1: Compress photos to the exact KB you need.
lede: Visa applications, civil service exams, and job portals demand strict file sizes like 20 KB or 50 KB. Pipit hits your exact target size on the first try without guessing, blurring, or uploading to a server.
free_note: Free. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
kb20_note: Binary search compression: Dimensions automatically scaled to 720 × 540 px to guarantee staying under 20 KB while preserving facial clarity.
kb50_note: Exact target hit: 48.7 KB is safely below the 50 KB ceiling. Sharp edges, clean contrast, and readable text for official submissions.
kb100_note: High-resolution output: 1600 × 1200 px at 96.5 KB. Rich details for job portals, identity documents, and academic uploads.
kb200_note: Retains 2048 × 1536 px resolution with 94.6% size reduction. Balanced high-fidelity compression for online forms.
orig_note: Original uncompressed camera photograph: 4096 × 3072 px, 3.5 MB file size. Far too large for government and exam upload systems.
console_note: Simulated using Pipit's on-device binary compression engine. Switch between Result and Original to inspect image crispness.
screens_title: Built for strict upload forms and everyday photos.
screens_sub: From 3.5 MB down to exact kilobytes, without guesswork or server uploads.

shot.result_body: From 3.5 MB down to 153 KB. Pipit's binary search engine calculates the exact compression curve to hit your target under the limit.
shot.result_alt: Pipit result screen showing file size reduction from 3.5 MB to 153 KB
shot.limit_body: Quick chips for 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, or enter any custom number of kilobytes your form specifies.
shot.limit_alt: Pipit max file size screen with quick chips for 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, and 200 KB
shot.resize_body: Resize by exact width and height, percentage, fit within bounding box, or fit inside a fixed canvas with custom padding.
shot.resize_alt: Pipit resize settings screen with pixel dimensions and aspect ratio options

screens_note: Screens show actual Pipit Android app UI with example photo.
spec_title: Official passport, visa, and exam standards.
spec_sub: Never worry about photo rejections due to wrong dimensions, improper aspect ratios, or distorted scaling.
spec_passport_desc: Standard dimension required for Schengen, US, and UK visa applications and biometric passports.
spec_exam_desc: Strict pixel standards for civil service registrations, professional certifications, and student exams.
spec_social_desc: Clean aspect ratios for profile avatars, resume attachments, and digital employment verification.
format_title: Convert formats & batch up to 100 images.
format_sub: Process single images with surgery-like precision, or crunch entire photo batches in seconds.
fmt_jpeg_desc: Universal compatibility. Uses smart binary search to maximize quality while staying strictly under your KB target.
fmt_png_desc: Lossless graphics with full transparency support. Perfect for signatures, stamps, and official seals.
fmt_webp_desc: Next-generation image format. Achieves up to 30% smaller file sizes than JPEG at identical visual quality.
batch_card_desc: Process up to 100 photos in a single queue. Apply unified KB limits, resizing rules, and format conversions in seconds.
honest_title: Your photos never leave your phone.
nots: No account, no registration, and no login required.
No photos, ID cards, passport scans, or signatures are ever sent to an external server.
No watermarks added to your images, ever.
No monthly subscription traps. Pro is a one-time purchase.
honest_body: All compression, cropping, and format conversions happen 100% on your device using Android's native hardware-accelerated Canvas and Bitmap pipelines. Completely offline, zero network exposure.
pro_title: Single-image resizing and KB compression are free.
pro_body: Pipit Pro is an optional one-time purchase, not a subscription. It removes ads, unlocks batch processing for up to 100 images, and lets you save up to 20 custom presets for repeated form submissions.
